title: Shrink packaged crate under the crates.io 10 MiB limit

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Intent: the release-plz publish of botspy v0.2.0 failed with HTTP 413 — the packaged crate is ~11.9 MiB, over the crates.io 10 MiB limit (docs/diagrams PNG/SVG assets dominate). Fix: replace the `exclude` list in Cargo.toml with an explicit `include` allowlist (src/, features/ — which src/spec embeds via include_str! — Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md). Verified with real tool output: cargo package --list (201 -> 90 files), cargo package (12,504,802 -> 141,764 bytes), cargo publish --dry-run (90 files, 571.5 KiB unpacked, 138.4 KiB compressed), and full cargo test green. Added a CI package-size job that fails above 9 MiB. No publish/tag/main changes from this task; the maintainer reruns the release.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: PR opened: https://github.com/DataParade-io/BotSpy/pull/15 (targets develop). Local verification: cargo package --list 201 -> 90 files; cargo package 12,504,802 -> 141,764 bytes; cargo publish --dry-run green; full cargo test green (BDD: 40 features, 213 scenarios, 923 steps). CI first run failed: the committed issue JSON contained the old org name in this task's comments; comments repointed to the new org. CI re-running on the rebased branch. Task stays in_progress until the change lands; the maintainer reruns the release-plz publish after merge.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Rebased onto origin/develop (picks up README PR 16). Root cause of the red CI run 37136917747: the no_real_personal_data guard failed on the committed issue JSON because this task's comments carried the old org name. Fix: repointed all comments to the new org, repointed README URLs (21) and Cargo.toml repository to the new org, verified all six raw diagram image URLs return HTTP 200.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: CI green on rebased head 6dd4472 (run 37141362647): lint, package-size, and all 7 test jobs pass (macos-14, macos-15-intel, ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, windows-latest, musl x86_64 + aarch64). Post-rebase packaged crate: 153,969 bytes (92 files). Release dry-run dispatch on develop (run 37142811073) computed version 0.2.0 and skipped only the crates.io upload, tag v0.2.0, and GitHub release — confirming a push to main publishes botspy 0.2.0 via direct release-plz release, no binaries. The failed main rerun 37133510867 hit the same 413 (200 files, 11.8MiB compressed) that this PR fixes. PR marked ready for review; awaiting maintainer merge and release rerun.
